200 when the service can serve traffic. 503 in two cases: while
draining for shutdown (`{"status":"not_ready"}`), and while Postgres or
the Kafka broker is unreachable (problem `dependency-unavailable`, its
`detail` names the failing dependency: `postgres`, `kafka`). The
Postgres ping and the Kafka metadata request (an empty topic list is
healthy; topics are never required) are cached for 3 seconds and
bounded at 2 seconds.
